title: Igadi Yafunga Ngokukhanya
intro: Kwiiyure ezizolileyo ngaphambi kokuba kuphume ilanga, icebo lenziwa ngasese. Ilifa elichumayo lalilungele ukuvunwa, kodwa kwakufuneka lizimisele ukugcina zonke iziqhamo kude nabo basweleyo. Kusasa, yonke into yayiza kubonakala ingaqhelekanga, kwaye isifundo sasiza kugrunjwa sibe ngamasebe amnyama kubo bonke abacingayo.
clues: Sizuze ilifa legadi echumayo saza safunga ukuba siza kuzivunela zonke iziqhamo zayo.
Safunga ukuba siza kuphuma kusasa xa amahlwempu acela isabelo sawo esalele.
Sikhuphele ngaphandle naluphi na uhlobo lwesifungo sethu saza sathintela ilungelo labasweleyo ngaphandle kokutsho ukuba uAllah uyathanda na.
Saphuma sincokola ukuba singavumeli mntu ulihlwempu ukuba angene emyezweni wethu ngaloo mini.
Sasicinga ukuba sinokukwazi ukuqokelela yonke into size sithintele nabani na oqokeleleyo ukuba angathabathi nxalenye.
Savuka safumana igadi yethu yonakele ebusuku, imnyama ngokungathi ivuniwe, saza sathi siswele kwaye siyaguquka.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
